description: Source code for the 'du_cell_group_config_pool' class and related functions, managing cell and UE configurations in a scheduler context for 5G NR (3GPP) specifications.

classes.name: du_cell_config_pool
classes.description: Manages individual cell configuration pools, including updating UE configurations.

classes.name: du_cell_group_config_pool
classes.description: Manages a group of cell configurations and UE addition/reconfiguration within the group.

methods.name: update_ue
methods.description: Updates UE configuration based on current cell and BWP settings.

methods.name: add_bwp
methods.description: Adds a BWP (Bandwidth Part) configuration to UE response.

methods.name: add_cell
methods.description: Adds a new cell configuration to the group.

methods.name: rem_cell
methods.description: Removes a cell configuration from the group.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a new UE with specific configuration to the group.

methods.name: reconf_ue
methods.description: Reconfigures an existing UE with new parameters.
